title: report.py support-overview --output-mode json
description: Domain Connect adoption and support over time (GitHub issue #211): two time series, oldest first. 'adoption' has one row per import (completed and hygiene-pruned ones; in-progress ones too with --include-incomplete); 'ecosystem' has one row per full support sweep. Stacks are counted by each DNS provider's current providerId; a provider declaring none is in no stack.

rows.description: Ordered by import_id ascending. An import with neither live data nor a snapshot has no row.

One row per support sweep of the series, oldest first: a full sweep (every template on every DNS provider) or a weekly sweep (every template on the DNS providers supporting one when it started; the others' state is carried forward), not told apart. Support observed during the scoped and propagation runs in between counts towards the preceding sweep of the series. Sweeps before the first support event have no row.

status.description: imports.status, or 'pruned' once hygiene has deleted the import's rows and only its snapshot remains.

started_at.description: imports.created_at. For an import pruned before per-import snapshots existed, inferred from the import_id (an epoch timestamp); null when that is not a plausible date.

completed_at.description: imports.completed_at; null while the import is in progress, or when an import pruned before per-import snapshots existed didn't keep it.

zone_domains.description: The distinct delegated domains of the import's zone files, summed over its zones, before sampling (GitHub issue #218); null when its zones are unknown.

dc_domains.description: Scanned domains whose Domain Connect URL is attributed to a DNS provider (the sum of the import's domain share). null when the import has no share data.

dc_pct.description: dc_domains / scanned_domains, as a percentage; null when either is unknown or nothing was scanned.

dc_domains_total.description: Every scanned domain with a Domain Connect URL, attributed to a DNS provider or not (at least dc_domains). null for an import pruned before per-import snapshots existed.

dc_total_pct.description: dc_domains_total / scanned_domains, as a percentage; null when either is unknown or nothing was scanned.

dns_providers.description: DNS providers with at least one attributed domain in the import; null when the import has no share data.

stacks.description: Distinct current providerIds of those DNS providers; null when the import has no share data.

supporting_dns_providers.description: DNS providers supporting at least one template version once the sweep had run.

supporting_stacks.description: Distinct current providerIds of those DNS providers.

supported_templates.description: Templates (service provider, service) supported by at least one DNS provider, in any version.

supported_combinations.description: Distinct (DNS provider, template) pairs with support, versions folded together.

known_dns_providers.description: DNS providers first seen before the next series sweep's start, any time for the last row: the same window as the support counts (current dns_providers rows).

published_templates.description: Stored templates whose first version was added before the next series sweep's start, any time for the last row: the same window as the support counts.
